pair.title: Connect your Candela
pair.bluetooth: Move the switch underneath the lamp to the Bluetooth position and place it near Homey. Then continue to search for lights.
pair.phone: Disconnect the lamp from the Yeelight app and other Bluetooth controllers first. The lamp may accept only one connection at a time.
pair.model: Requires the original Bluetooth Candela (YLFW01YL, micro USB). Candela versions without Bluetooth cannot be connected. Patterns are generated by Homey.

errors.bluetooth: Cannot connect to Candela. Check its charge, Bluetooth switch and distance from Homey, and disconnect other Bluetooth controllers. Homey will retry automatically.
